svg.aria-label: A professional with a folder of their work sends it past three gates toward a tall stack of openings. At each gate pages are lost: the automated screen catches a page for a work gap and another for lacking an exact keyword, the recruiter faces a heap of near identical letters some written by a machine, and the hiring manager holds a posting whose requirements pile up like the rings of a tree. Months of search go by and nothing is measured.
svg.title: The pain: evidence is lost at the gates and nobody sees what
